description: Brother, it's chess. I can't help you if you don't know what chess is.
name: Chess

objectives.co_op_rules: Play hand and brain chess if 2P co-op. If 3P, have two brains and one hand. If 4P, have two brain and two hand and alternate moves.
objectives.versus_tertiary: Play against each other, each drawing a different secondary. The primary objectives are not needed.
